title: Beneficient 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Beneficient (BENF), a Nasdaq-listed micro-cap company, completed a primary capital transaction on April 8, 2026, issuing 875,214 shares of Series B-10 Resettable Convertible Preferred Stock in exchange for acquiring a limited partner interest in an investment fund with a net asset value of $8.75 million.
key_points: Beneficient acquired a limited partner interest in an investment fund with NAV of $8.75 million
Company issued 875,214 shares of Series B-10 Preferred Stock to the customer
Conversion price: $3.5479 per share, subject to monthly resets with a floor of $1.2418 per share
Maximum potential Class A common stock issuance: 7,047,947 shares upon full conversion
The transaction relied on Section 4(a)(2) exemption and Regulation D (unregistered sale)
Company expects to recognize approximately $1.2 million unrealized gain from the transaction
